summary:
Iter57 verified all 4 approved features end-to-end. Backend pytest (test_iter57_export_jml_digest.py): 12 passed, 1 skipped (strip_flow skipped in one rerun because the fixture had already stripped the only mover with carried_over>0; that same test PASSED in the first run — response 200 with ticket.number and stripped_count>=1). Verified: (a) GET /api/sap/workflow/activity/export?format=csv 200 text/csv with header row, ?format=pdf 200 application/pdf starting %PDF, ?format=xml 400, ?format=csv&days=1 200. (b) POST /api/sap/jml/{ref}/strip-carried-over on a P-004x mover returned ok:true, stripped_count>=1, ticket.number set, systems_touched present. Second call on a mover with 0 carried-over returned 400 'No carried-over roles to strip'. Unknown ref returned 404. Requires JSON body {reason}. (c) POST /api/sap/governance-digest/send returned 200 with ok:true, recipients:[jblan2026@gmail.com], sent>=0 and data containing open_sod/sev/autorem_24h/residual_count/top. In UI flow the same call returned sent:1 (real Emergent-managed Resend delivery). (d) POST /api/cron/daily-drift-digest without auth returns 401; with Bearer WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET returns 200 {status:accepted}. Regression pass: GET/POST /api/sap/autoremediation and /run 200, /api/sap/workflow/activity 200 with tickets. 

Frontend Playwright (cookie login via data-testid=auth-submit): /app/workflow — wf-export-csv & wf-export-pdf visible, both trigger real file downloads (sap-workflow-evidence.csv / .pdf) and show sonner toasts 'Workflow CSV/PDF evidence pack exported'. wf-row-* click opens wf-detail with wf-stages timeline. /app/lifecycle — jml-movers-panel + 4 mover rows (P-0014, P-0039, P-0045, P-0046) render, jml-mover-open-* opens jml-mover-dialog with side-by-side mover-role-current + mover-role-birthright showing CARRIED OVER (red) vs BIRTHRIGHT (green) tags; jml-mover-strip-btn and mover-ai-review present. Strip button correctly disables when carried_over_count==0 (label switches to 'No carried-over access'). /app/sod — after fix, autorem-toggle / autorem-action / autorem-run / autorem-digest all render; clicking autorem-digest fires POST /sap/governance-digest/send → 200 and shows toast 'SAP Governance Digest emailed to 1 recipient(s) — jblan2026@gmail.com'.

minor.issue: Under heavy repeated calls (esp. after the folded cron kicks the same digest as a background task), Emergent-managed Resend upstream returns 429 Too Many Requests and 'sent' drops to 0 while the endpoint still returns ok:true. Consider a per-org 60s dedupe/backoff so on-demand sends don't collide with the folded cron's background dispatch, or surface a friendlier 'digest is being generated / try again in a minute' toast when sent<len(recipients).

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: digestBusy is not defined — the new 'Email governance digest' button referenced digestBusy but the useState hook was never declared. This crashed the entire /app/sod page (Uncaught runtime error banner, no autorem-* controls rendered). Fixed here by adding const [digestBusy, setDigestBusy] = useState(false); on line 39. Please double-check main agent's original intent.

issues: Radix a11y warning still fires ('DialogContent requires a DialogTitle') from iter56 — cosmetic only.

action_items: Review the SodCommandCenter.jsx digestBusy hook I added (state declaration was missing entirely — very small fix but you should confirm intent).
Consider a small dedupe/backoff on POST /sap/governance-digest/send so the folded cron's background dispatch doesn't 429 the on-demand endpoint (leaves sent:0).
critical_code_review_comments: SodCommandCenter.jsx introduced 'digestBusy' usage without declaring the useState hook — this crashes the whole page and should have been caught by a smoke render before ship. Added the missing hook.
sap_uac.py is 2236 lines (up from 2088 in iter55). Split into modules (workflow.py, jml.py, digest.py, autoremediation.py) is overdue.

MoverStripBody requires reason (default '') but the endpoint returns 422 (not 400) when the body is entirely absent; UI always sends a body so it's a non-issue, but a Body(None) fallback would make the endpoint more forgiving for CLI/curl callers.

governance_digest_send silently swallows Resend 429 and returns sent:0 with ok:true — the response shape is correct but callers/tests naturally read sent>=1 as success. Consider returning {ok:false, throttled:true} or at least a delivered/skipped breakdown.

success_rate.backend: 12/12 executed pass (1 skipped when no carried-over mover remained)
success_rate.frontend: 4/4 flows verified — Workflow CSV+PDF export with toasts + row-detail modal, Lifecycle Movers panel + deep-dive dialog with CARRIED OVER vs BIRTHRIGHT tags + strip button state, SoD governance digest (after fixing crash) with 200 response and 'emailed to 1 recipient(s)' toast, Cron folded auth check

test_credentials: jblan2026@gmail.com / Obserra2026! (cookie-based login via data-testid=auth-submit). WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET read from /app/backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: During backend tests: 1 CHG ticket via strip_carried_over on a Procurement/Finance mover carrying Z_SD_BILLING or Z_MM_PO_APPROVER (roles were removed from the account); 1 governance-digest email attempt (real Resend send, deliverable=1 in the UI run, throttled=0 in the pytest run due to prior cron/UI dispatch); 1 folded cron invocation which also fired run_sap_autoremediation_all + run_sap_governance_digest as background tasks. All state is consistent with iter56's baseline; no accounts left in a broken state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) After iter57 both P-0045 and P-0046 mover accumulations have been stripped in this session; to re-test the strip flow the main agent needs to re-seed the sap_engine mover-accumulation scenarios (or re-run the seed script). 2) The Emergent Resend endpoint is aggressively rate-limited (429) when the folded cron + on-demand digest fire together; expect sent:0 occasionally — the endpoint still returns ok:true. 3) SodCommandCenter.jsx now has const [digestBusy, setDigestBusy] = useState(false) declared alongside aremBusy on line 39. 4) POST /api/sap/jml/{ref}/strip-carried-over requires JSON body {"reason": "..."} — returns 422 (not 400) if body is missing. 5) autorem-last-cron test-id only renders after the folded cron has recorded arem.config.last_cron_at — expect count 0 until first successful cron run in this fork.
rca of the issue: SoD page crash RCA: /app/frontend/src/pages/SodCommandCenter.jsx line 175 references `digestBusy` (in the autorem-digest Button's disabled prop and label) but the useState hook `const [digestBusy, setDigestBusy] = useState(false)` was never declared. React threw a ReferenceError which the ErrorBoundary caught and rendered as an 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay, unmounting the entire SoD command center including autorem-toggle/action/run. Repro: 1) login as admin, 2) navigate to /app/sod → red error banner appears, 3) DevTools console shows 'ReferenceError: digestBusy is not defined at SodCommandCenter'. Fix applied by adding the missing useState declaration next to aremBusy. Verified fix by reloading /app/sod — page renders, autorem-digest button visible and functional (POST /sap/governance-digest/send returns 200 and success toast fires).
